verdicts.reason: A enlarges the headline but crams the date card, headphone circle, body copy and CTA into the right third: the body copy and the RSVP button sit on top of the headphone graphic, the headphones are cropped behind the card, and 'Listening Session' is shrunk to an unreadable caption under the card, which breaks the hierarchy and reading order. B is basically the original shrunk uniformly and nothing collides. Its flaws: the orphaned 'live' in the headline, small body and CTA text, and a wide empty left margin (~115px) with the content packed toward the right, so it reads as a shrink rather than a deliberate rearrangement.
